items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: We know him pretty well because he does the Jazz Nativity with us every year... we see him every year at that, and so we’re always in the same dressing room.

ctx.x: And for me it was a great pleasure working with Grady Tate on drums.

And I really loved Christian’s playing. And he’s such a big, warm guy, like he just gives you hugs and says, “yeah, it was good playing with you again.” And with Grady, after we finished, I’m going to tell you this and you can cut it if you like, I went over to him, we went down to the dressing room and I put my arm around him and says, “Grady, it was just wonderful, because playing with you is really a comfort.” And he says “yeah, like a jock strap.”
